name: risegen-access-keys
displayName: risegen-access-keys — create, look up, or reuse RiseGen credentials
description: Procedure for any code assistant to reuse or create a RiseGen credential: user inference API key, OAuth device grant, or application client credentials.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: Reuse a user inference key before creating one. Device grant yields a session, not the gateway key. Application client secrets are not a provider API key.
usage.engineers: Three families. Go types in api/internal/auth/types.go are the scope authority.
usage.founders: One key per person is reused. Secrets stay out of git and out of chat.
